notes.title: Demo Levels Re-made
notes.notes:
We recently had our first playtest of the first levels of the game. This is a major milestone as the game demo is one step closer to release!

Based on the feedback we learned that some levels were too difficult, some were too confusing, and some were too easy. (and some were actually really good!)

We have now almost completely re-made or adjusted the first 15 levels more a more linear and appropriate difficulty curve. 

Soon these levels will go through a second round of testing to ensure the changes have been an improvement, as well as finding out if the new levels need further adjusting.

Cheers!

// BATTLE LAB
